summary: Account c.aydin@aegean.edu shows confirmed post-auth abuse via an OWA inbox forwarding rule to c.aydin.ogr@proton.me (F3). Suspicious sign-ins from AS60068 Datacamp Limited (DE) outside baseline, 11 events (F2). Impossible travel from Manisa to Frankfurt in 156 minutes (F1). Risk Gate verdict: contain, confidence 0.78.

risk.rationale: Confirmed account takeover chain: external/datacenter sign-ins (F2) with impossible travel (F1) establishing unauthorized access, plus an OWA inbox forwarding rule to an external ProtonMail address (F3) providing persistence/exfiltration. All three findings are CONFIRMED and mutually reinforcing under T1078.004/T1114.003. The VPN KEV claim is rejected as not tied to this account's sign-ins. Decision: contain.
